title: A Mortgage Takes Forty-Odd Days and Spends Most of Them Waiting: Where the Time Actually Goes, and the Days an AI Agent Gives Back
summary: The industry still measures time to close in the mid-forties of days, and very little of that is work. It is a loan sitting in a queue between two people who are each busy with a different file. A production leader's map of where the dead time hides, which regulatory clocks keep running while the loan waits, and which gaps an AI agent closes without touching a decision anyone is accountable for.
